FundTransferRequest.name: FundTransferRequest
FundTransferRequest.description: Represents the details of fund transfer request between two financial accounts.

CaseId.description: The Case that's associated with the fund transfer request.

Description.description: The additional details or notes about the fund transfer request.

EndDate.description: The date on which the final transfer of the recurring series is scheduled to be sent.

Frequency.description: The interval at which the fund transfers occur in a recurring fund transfer request.

FromId.description: The source from which the funds are transferred.

InstallmentCount.description: The total number of payments to be made in a recurring fund transfer request.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Name.description: An auto-generated number assigned to the record.

OwnerId.description: ID of the user who created the relationship record.

ProcessingReferenceNumber.description: The unique identifier of the fund transfer request in an external system.

StartDate.description: The date on which the first transfer is scheduled to be sent.

Status.description: Specifies the status of the fund transfer request.

ToFinancialAccountId.description: The financial account to which the funds are being transferred.

ToId.description: The destination to which the funds are being transferred.

TransferFailureReason.description: The specific error or reason provided when the fund transfer failed.

TransferType.description: Specifies the type of the fund transfer request.
